This studio builds a physics surrogate model (scientific ml) using ERA5 Reanalysis. The work is set at the city scale, with Barcelona as the case study. The model maps where street interventions would most improve accessibility, and results are shown in an interactive dashboard for planners. Maps of predicted heat and exposure highlight priority streets for shading, greening and cool materials.
